findings.description: enable_key_rotation is not set, so it defaults to false and the CMK protecting audit trail data never rotates its backing key material. Long-lived key material increases exposure if the key is ever compromised and fails common audit-log encryption baselines.

No policy argument is supplied, so AWS attaches the default key policy that grants kms:* to the account root, delegating key use and administration to IAM. Any principal in the account with broad IAM permissions can use, disable, or schedule deletion of the key protecting audit evidence, rather than a least-privilege set of key users and administrators.
